notes.title: Version 0.13.1 - Content Patch & minor bugfixing
notes.notes:
New Major Feature - Alchemy

Visit Kai's shop in Zendalia to start crafting your elixirs! The recipes work the same as those for cooking, so make sure you learn what you have in your inventory.

New Major Feature - Richi-Box 3000
We've placed a jukebox in the Dohan tavern to play any previously heard tracks from our OST. The name is an homage to our amazing composer Richi! Make sure to check it out!

Camping & Meals


 Camping now heals 100% of the party's HP
 Meals now grant experience points
 Meal buff durations normalized

- morning camp meals expire at the end of the in-game day
- nighttime camp meals expire at the end of the following in-game day

Bugfixes

- Fixed a couple of small issues with the Blacksmith UI
- Fixed a bug that caused the Groblin King fight to sometimes break the turn order

notes.title: Version 0.12.2.02 - Patch
notes.notes:
Combat

 Soul Release SP cost reduced to 50 (was 100) and gave it a 5 turn cooldown.
 Rally base healing reduced to 25 (was 50), but now gains and additional 3 healing each level.
 The first party member ability rune is now unlocked at level 3 (was 7).
 Temporarily removed an ability from the second boss fight that was not working as intended.
 Status effects no longer persist on party members that have been "downed".


UI

 Item tooltips now properly appear in combat.
 Fixed a bug where Ritual Blades would show in the main panel before acquiring them.
 Fixed a bug where Party Member ability pages would persist in the menu after they have left the party.
 Fixed a bug where Party Members would appear in the item use screen after they have left the party.
 Fixed a bug where Party Members who have not yet joined the party would appear in the weapon upgrade interface.
 Fixed a bug causing players not to see the level 15 Party Member mastery abilities.
 Fixed various inconsistencies on the Party Member ability panels.
 Fixed an issue where leaving to the main menu and re-entering the game would sometimes cause tooltips to not appear.

notes.title: Shop QoL improvements & bugfixes micropatch
notes.notes:
Hey all,

We just published a small update to Rising Spire, dealing with some minor bugs and adding some quality of life improvements mostly focused on the Dohan Shop in game.

Bugfixes


 Fixed an issue causing the Jack'o'Mama fight to freeze
 The Setup Camp button now correctly displays the input key as F instead of X
 Twilight Moss now appears only at night, as the lord intended
 Fixed tooltip descriptions for runes and abilities
 Fixed a visual bug that caused Nephilim abilities to be displayed wonkily in the Abilities Menu
 Fixed a bug that caused the amount of coin in the inventory to not save / load properly
 Fixed a bug that would have you purchase Small Hunches in the shop once you had already purchased a different item
 Fixed a bug that allowed you to keep buying or selling a Stack of items, even though they technically they were out of stock
 Fixed a bug that displayed inventory items as white squares for some players.


Quality of Life changes to the Shop


 Default background color for the different items is no longer purple
 Dohan's Famous Grilled Cheese now properly fits in the shop's inventory
 Recipes are purchasable only one time (and passed down from generation to generation in a battered, old recipe book)
 You are now notified you're poor in case you don't have enough coin to purchase a particular item
 The shop inventory now has a proper selector animation


Additional note

We are still investigating any potential other issues with the Jack'o'Mama fight.

As usual, please let us know if you encounter any bugs or issues, either here on Steam, or directly on Discord. We highly appreciate it! 🖤

Happy Christmas weekend!
- The LFB Studios team

notes.title: Act 1 Content + Polish update
notes.notes:
Thank you for playing Rising Spire! 💙

The first content patch in the game's Early Access stage is here, and it also includes lots of polish for already existing content and systems. Let's take a look!

New Content


 New side quests

Take your time exploring Dohan, and you will be greeted with new faces, ready to send you in the jaws of dangers for some rewards that will definitely help you save the world, mhm.


 New dialogue / character interactions

Won't go into spoilers, but I will tell you that we added a few more scenes where Atlas interacts with other characters to try and get an understanding of what is actually going on around him. Can't make any promises for Atlas himself, but it's sure to help you, the player!


 Visual content

Added more flavor to the overworld. This includes lots of changes to the town of Dohan in particular, but also visual updates / more items in the Dohan Forest where the biggest part of Arc 1 takes place: new grasses, trees, landmarks, textures, and VFX.

Polished Content

Let's go over the updates that we've implemented for the content that was already in the game with the original Early Access launch.

Enemies and Combat

 General battle balance: increased difficulty of standard enemies and minor boss battles
 Reduced difficulty of the current final battle (if you managed to beat her before, hat's off to you, major respect)
 Added more abilities to enemies
 Added more animations to enemies
 Battle UI updated
 Battle scenes updated

In other words, the battles are generally more challenging, and also way better looking.

Party Members

 Modified the starting stats values
 Stats are now gained for all party members on combat level increase
 Weapon mastery now increases base damage done with that particular weapon

 
Player Menu & General UI

 Major changes to general appearance (and I mean major)
 Increased inventory size
 Added new icons for inventory items
 Added currency and epitaph tracker in the inventory
 Tooltip style changed to better accommodate various screen sizes
 Added new rewards notifications system

Everything UI related got a facelift and is now more helpful for players.

Other

 Camping can now be done at any time as means to fast forward from dawn to dusk, or dusk to dawn.
 Journal updated both in terms of appearance, and also helpfulness (no more cryptic entries that tell you nothing about next steps).
 Maps (M) have been updated in the Journal to better reflect each scene and to help you figure out which direction to go.
 Each area has a distinct name now, displayed upon entering the scene. We know it's difficult to not get lost in a forest - this should make exploration much easier.


Bugs and known issues

 Fixed several big and small bugs from the previous public patch
 Known issue: the epitaph tracker will only start tracking the epitaphs after accepting Valentin's quest (previously read epitaphs will be tracked accordingly)
 Known issue: the tooltips for the Twin Blades runes are missing description.


Aaand that's a general overview for today's update! If you find any bugs or issues, please reach out to let us know. You can open a discussion thread here on Steam, leave a comment to this update, or simply write to us on Discord - we have a dedicated channel for bug reporting and it's easier to ask for details and all that stuff. A huge thank you, this is much appreciated!

Enjoy, have fun, and let us know what you think!


Love,
The LFB Studios team
